snippet.title: FBI Arrests Massachusetts Teen Over Trump Threat, Finds Mass Shooting Messages
snippet.description:
An 18-year-old Massachusetts man has been arrested and charged with making a threat against President Donald Trump, after an FBI investigation uncovered additional online messages referencing mass shootings, firearms and violence.

Federal, state and local law enforcement officers arrested Trenton Touch during an early-morning raid at his home in Tewksbury, Massachusetts.

How did the FBI investigation begin?

According to investigators, Meta alerted the FBI in September to four Instagram accounts containing threats of violence.

The FBI linked the accounts to Touch.

Investigators say one account sent another user a photograph of a firearm in June, along with a message threatening to kill President Trump.

Other messages allegedly discussed military-style equipment and carrying out shootings.

The FBI also identified an August message that investigators believe referenced a mass shooter responsible for a 2014 attack in California.

Authorities say threatening messages were sent to hundreds of people over several months.

FBI searches homes in Massachusetts and New Hampshire

During a search of Touch's Tewksbury home, investigators say they recovered a revolver matching photographs shared through the social media accounts.

Authorities also reported finding materials associated with white supremacist and Nazi ideology, camouflage clothing, military-style knives and a hatchet.

A separate search at Touch's grandparents' home in New Hampshire uncovered a firearm investigators say was pictured in connection with the alleged threat against Trump.

Neighbors describe early-morning raid

Tewksbury resident and Vietnam veteran Richard Frank described hearing loud explosions around 6 a.m. as officers carried out the operation.

Frank said the sounds of flashbang devices startled him before he witnessed officers taking a man into custody.

Police say investigation may have prevented violence

Tewksbury's police chief credited investigators for taking the threats seriously, saying their work may have prevented a mass casualty incident.

Touch has been charged in connection with the alleged threat against the president. The other messages and materials are described as findings of the investigation, not additional convictions.

snippet.title: Why Saying “I Hate You” Can Mean the Exact Opposite 👇
snippet.description:
Why Saying “I Hate You” Can Mean the Exact Opposite 👇

He’s listing everything he claims to despise —  
the way she talks, the way she drives, even her laugh.

The more he tries to push her away with harsh words and petty dislikes,  
the clearer it becomes that his feelings are anything but hate.

There’s a raw, honest vulnerability in admitting how deeply someone affects you,  
even if it’s wrapped in frustration and anger.

Because sometimes, the things we say we hate are just the signs we care the most.

👉 Emotions are messy — love and pain often sound alike.  
👉 Trying to mask affection with anger only reveals how much someone means to us.  
👉 Honest expression, even when complicated, can be the start of true connection.

The uncomfortable truth?

We often confuse intensity of feeling with negativity.  
What looks like hatred can be love afraid to show itself plainly.  
And the hardest part is admitting what your heart really feels.

So the real question is:

How many of us hide love behind “hate” because we’re too scared to be vulnerable? 👇💬

snippet.title: California's $2,000 Gun Permit Just Got The DOJ's Attention
snippet.description:
Imagine having to pay **$2,000 just to exercise your right to carry a firearm.**

That's approximately what a first-time concealed carry applicant could face in Glendale, California, according to the Department of Justice.

And now the DOJ is threatening legal action.

Glendale reportedly increased its initial carry license application fee from $100 to $1,078. When additional costs are included, the total can approach $2,000. Renewals can run approximately $1,300.

I've been warning about this exact problem for years.

**When the government requires a permission slip to exercise a constitutional right, it also gets to determine how expensive that permission slip becomes.**

And when those fees become unaffordable, who gets left behind?

People who can't afford thousands of dollars just to legally protect themselves in public.

In this video, I break down the DOJ's warning to Glendale, the constitutional questions surrounding excessive firearm licensing fees, and a particularly important passage from the Supreme Court's 2022 decision in *N.Y. State Rifle & Pistol Association v. Bruen*.

The Court specifically acknowledged that exorbitant fees could potentially deny ordinary citizens their right to public carry.

We also examine a separate DOJ challenge involving concealed carry fees in San Jose.

**Should the government be allowed to charge thousands of dollars before someone can exercise a constitutional right?**

“The Albanese government has backed down on its controversial plan to sell Victoria Barracks in Sydney,” Ms Rogers said. 

“Today, amongst the fanfare of the backflip the prime minister made, an extraordinary admission.

“I find that astounding. Anthony Albanese was prepared to sell off one of Australia's most historic military sites without ever having set foot inside it.”

दीपावली के मौके पर पीएम मोदी आज छत्तीसगढ़ के बस्तर में हैं.. सीआरपीएफ जवानों के साथ दिवाली का त्योहार मना रहे हैं.. भारत माता की जय के नारों से जवानों ने पीएम मोदी का वेलकम किया.. पीएम ने यहां पहुंचकर जवानों के त्याग, बलिदान और तपस्या को नमन किया है.. बस्तर की धरती से पीएम मोदी ने एक बार फिर दिमागी नक्सलियों पर अटैक किया है.. और कहा कि जंगलों से हथियारी नक्सली तो खत्म हो गए हैं.. लेकिन दिमागी नक्सली ने कई संगठनों पर कब्जा कर रखा है..जो देश के संविधान के खिलाफ लोगों को उकसा रहे हैं 


On the occasion of Diwali, PM Modi is in Bastar, Chhattisgarh today. He is celebrating the festival of Diwali with CRPF jawans. The jawans welcomed PM Modi with slogans of Bharat Mata Ki Jai. After reaching here, the PM paid tribute to the sacrifice, dedication and penance of the jawans. From the land of Bastar, PM Modi once again attacked the mindless Naxalites and said that armed Naxalites have been eliminated from the forests, but mindless Naxalites have taken over many organizations, who are inciting people against the Constitution of the country.

snippet.title: 원팬으로 한방에 만드는 방법!
snippet.description:
💡오늘 사용한 '사각 계란말이팬'
👉영상 속 제품 스티커 클릭하세요~ 🙌

💚 오늘 레시피 유용하셨다면
➰공유 ➰구독 ➰댓글
부탁드려요

솔직히 이 방법 알기 전에는
번거로워서 잘 안 해 먹던 요리인데요~

이렇게 원팬으로 간단하게 만드니까
자주 해 먹게 되는 거 있죠? ㅎㅎ

좋아하는 재료 골라 넣으면
이것만으로도 든든한 한 끼가 되고
오므라이스 먹는 느낌이라
아이들 메뉴로도 진짜 딱이거든요!

제 영상 따라 하면서
실패 없이 예쁘게 만들어 보세요~! ㅎㅎ


⭐스팸 채소 계란말이밥⭐

🍳재료 (2개 분량)
스팸 1캔 (200g), 계란 5개, 당근 20g, 대파 20g, 밥 1공기(210g), 소금, 식용유
*간장 양념*
간장 0.5T, 맛술 0.5T, 올리고당 0.5T (1개 분량)

🥢레시피
1. 스팸은 작게 깍뚝 썰어서 팬에 볶아주세요.
2. 간장 0.5T, 맛술 0.5T, 올리고당 0.5T 넣고 단짠하게 조려주세요.
3. 밥 1공기 추가해서 밥을 부시면서 볶아주세요.
4. 사각팬 한쪽 끝으로 밥을 밀어서 꾹꾹 눌러 각을 잡아주고 반대쪽으로 밀어주세요.
5. 계란 5개에 다진 당근, 대파 넣고 섞은 다음 팬에 부어 넓게 펼쳐주고 밥밑을 들어 계란물을 채워주세요.
6. 약불로 천천히 익히다가 밥을 계란에 돌돌 말아서 계란말이로 만들어주세요.
7. 한 김 식혀서 한 입 크기로 자르면 완성입니다.

⭐Spam & Vegetable Egg Rice Roll⭐

 🍳 Ingredients (Makes 2)
1 can Spam (200 g), 5 eggs, 20 g carrot, 20 g green onion, 1 bowl cooked rice (210 g), salt, cooking oil
*Soy Sauce Seasoning (per serving): 0.5T soy sauce, 0.5T cooking wine, 0.5T oligosaccharide syrup

🥢 Recipe
1. Dice the Spam into small cubes and stir-fry in a pan.
2. Add 0.5T soy sauce, 0.5T cooking wine, and 0.5T oligosaccharide syrup. Simmer until well coated.
3. Add the rice and stir-fry, breaking up any clumps.
4. Push the rice to one end of the rectangular pan, press firmly into shape, then move it to the opposite side.
5. Beat 5 eggs with finely chopped carrot and green onion. Pour into the pan, spread evenly, and lift the rice slightly to let the egg flow underneath.
6. Cook slowly over low heat, then roll the rice up in the egg.
7. Let cool slightly, slice into bite-sized pieces, and enjoy!
